article.headline: Black Friday Toy Shopping: What COS Parents Need to Check Before Hitting “Buy”

research.facts:
Black Friday Toy Safety — What to Know Before You Shop
**Key Facts:**
- CPSC maintains a recall database at cpsc.gov/Recalls — HIGH (official site, known)
- Recent children's product recalls in November 2026 include: Qpancy children's pajamas (Nov 19, recall #27-094, 1,309 units, burn hazard, fails flammability standards) — HIGH (covered Nov 26, background context only)
- SHEIN toy set recall November 12, 2026 — approximately 265,000 units; parents told to stop use immediately — MEDIUM (from CPSC recall search results, not opened official page)
- Magnetic building cubes recall November 5, 2026 — high-powered magnets can be released if cubes break, ingestion risk — MEDIUM (from CPSC recall search results)
- Nursing pillows recall November 5, 2026 — can block infant's airway — MEDIUM (from CPSC recall search results)
- Arlopu slide playsets recall November 5, 2026 — openings can trap a child's head — MEDIUM (from CPSC recall search results)
- CPSC toy safety tips: Check age labels; look for "ASTM F963" compliance (toy safety standard); avoid toys with small parts for children under 3; check for button batteries, which pose ingestion hazard — HIGH (CPSC official guidance, well-established)
- Black Friday and Cyber Monday are the two biggest toy-buying days of the year — HIGH (industry-known fact)
- Age labels on toys are legally required under ASTM F963 standard — HIGH
**Sources:**
- CPSC Recalls: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls
- November 2026 recalls context from search results

article.headline: When the Holidays Feel Heavy: What the AAP Says About Kids and Seasonal Stress

research.facts:
Helping Kids Through Holiday Stress — AAP Guidance
**Key Facts:**
- Holiday stress affects children differently than adults — kids may show symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite, headaches, stomach aches — HIGH (multiple pediatric sources: University of Michigan, Mayo Clinic, CBS News Texas)
- Symptoms that persist more than 2 weeks warrant a pediatrician visit — HIGH (Michigan Medicine)
- University of Michigan poll of 2,020 parents found holiday logistics (shopping, tasks, finances) are the most common stressors — HIGH (U of Michigan study, cited in search results)
- Nearly a third of parents say stress comes from holiday shopping and tasks — HIGH (U of Michigan poll)
- Almost 50% of parents say most days their stress is completely overwhelming (2024 U.S. Surgeon General's report on parents) — HIGH (cited in October 2025 early-childhood health brief)
- AAP/healthychildren.org guidance: Holiday stress article on "Comfort and Joy" at healthychildren.org covers how families can enjoy holidays together — HIGH (healthychildren.org URL confirmed in search)
- Practical tips: maintain routines, model stress management, limit screen time, keep expectations realistic, involve kids in preparations — HIGH (from multiple AAP-linked sources)
- Persistent low mood in children is a legitimate concern worth discussing with pediatrician — HIGH (Michigan Medicine)
- Parents' own mental health matters and directly affects children — HIGH (Surgeon General's report context)
- Colorado Springs context: Thanksgiving weekend + upcoming holiday season = relevant timing — HIGH (editorial context)
**Sources:**
- HealthyChildren.org AAP: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/family-life/family-dynamics/Pages/Comfort-and-Joy-Family-Tips-for-Enjoying-the-Winter-Holidays.aspx
- Mayo Clinic holiday stress kids: https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org/discussion/mental-health-and-the-holidays-stress-for-kids/
- Michigan Medicine: https://www.michiganmedicine.org/childrens-health/could-holiday-stress-be-affecting-your-childs-holiday-joy

article.headline: Surviving Holiday Travel With Kids: A Practical Guide for COS Families

research.facts:
Holiday Travel With Kids — Survival Guide
**Key Facts:**

- Packing tips: snacks, entertainment, first-aid kit, familiar comfort items reduce stress — HIGH (general parenting guidance)
- Motion sickness in kids: ginger, fresh air, keeping eyes on the horizon, seated position — MEDIUM (medical guidance, not verified against primary source this session)
- COS context: I-25 corridor between Denver and COS is one of Colorado's busiest travel corridors at Thanksgiving — HIGH (road-trip context)
- Travel tips for local destinations: Old Colorado City, Garden of Gods (free), Skate in the Park ($15) are all reachable within COS without significant drive — HIGH (confirmed locations)
